BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


       SECTION 1. Tifie 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit
(Detached Housing) District, as shown on Map 6-H in the area bounded by:

      West 23'^*' Place; South Hoyne Avenue; a line 49.00 feet South of West 23'^''
      Place; and the alley next West of and parallel to South Hoyne Avenue,

to those of B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed Use District

       SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its
passage and due publication.




Common Address of Property: 2334-2336 South Hoyne Avenue
                                  NARRATIVE AND PLANS
                          FOR THE PROPOSED TYPE 1 APPLICATION
                              2334-2336 SOUTH HOYNE AVENUE

        The Application on behalf of the current property Owner, Diamond Properties Group, LLC,
is for a Zoning Map Amendment from RS-3 Residential Single Unit (Detached) District to B2-3
Neighborhood Mixed-Use District for purposes of subdividing one zoning lot into two zoning lots
from 49' x 104.50 into two zoning lots of 24' x 104.50 and 25' x 104.50 respectively (the property is a
Zoning Lot as defined in Section 17-17-02197).

        On the vacant lot, the Applicant intends to construct a three-story, three dweUing unit building
with three (3) off street parking spaces. There will be no change to the existing three (3) dwelling
unit building at 2334 South Hoyne. The footprint of the new Building at 2336 South Hoyne
shaU be approximately 19 feet by 70 feet in size, and the new building shall be 30 feet 2 inches high,
as defined by City Code.

SPECIFIC CRITERIA FOR THIS EQUITABLE TRANSIT SERVED LOCATION

         Two parking spaces arc provided at 2334 South Hoyne (there are required for three dwelling
units). 2334 South Hoyne is an Equitable Transit Served Location under 17-10-0102-B since it is 704
feet north of the Blue Island Route 60 CTA Bus I^ine:

       1. The Project complies with Section 17-10-0102-B, located 704 feet north of the Blue
          Island/60 CTA Bus route;
       2. The site is not a Pedestrian Street under 17-3-0504; (non-accessory parking abutting a
          Pedestrian Street is not applicable);
       3. The Project complies with the general goals set forth in the Transit Friendly Development
          Guide since it is located in a Local Activity Center Area as an in-fill development and both
          on a qualified CTA Bus route and in close proximit}' to the Blue Line;
       4. The Project will provide:
              a. 2334 South Hoyne: Two (2) parking spaces for three (3) dwelling units;
              b. 2336 South Hoyne: Three (3) parking spaces for three (3) dweUing units.
       5. The Project complies with the Travel Demand Study and Management Plan rules of the
          Chicago Department of Transportation.
